scenario: Timer facts are one-shot per LTAC.4.2 — the follow-up rule fires exactly once after the delay, then the timer fact is retracted. Pin: parent fires, advance clock past the after duration, follow-up fires exactly once (one rule_fire_begin for the after rule).
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

rule auto_off:
    Motion m where m.state == true
->
    log info "on"
    after 5_s:
        log info "off after delay"
